author: MushiMix
quote: Expectations mightve killed this game. The hype that something otherworldly would come to be flopped. The hyperrealism makes it feel slow, mundane and boring. Its a tecnichal advancement for sure but for the wrong reasons. Goodlooks zero personality type stuff. Its not as edgy as the rest of the gta games. And thats exactly my problem like is not funny. The game gets carried by its visuals and radio stations. Certain limitations make it feel like not gta and new features make it feel like not gta. In the end it feels like a life simulator and the point of gaming is to escape from reality.

author: MushiMix
quote: Definition of video games. Is a video game just to be a video game; fun yet gorgeous and meaningful. It immerses you in the imaginavite world of hyrule where the greed of a man called ganon corrupts hyrule with evil. You play as Link, a young boy whos courage leads him to save hyrule. Kids will absolutely love it. And adults well get to experience a world like finally putting on glasses and seeing the true beauty that the world can be. Thats how it feels. Best game ever.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
